metrics.n: METRICS clause: aggregate, derived, window and semi-additive metrics, with PUBLIC or PRIVATE access modifiers.

dimensions.n: DIMENSIONS and FACTS with filters, sample values, enum flags. YAML adds time_dimensions. No hierarchy construct in the spec.

relationships.n: RELATIONSHIPS with primary keys, many-to-one, one-to-one, ASOF, bridge tables. USING relationship path and range joins are Preview.

synonyms.n: WITH SYNONYMS, COMMENT, SAMPLE_VALUES, IS_ENUM, plus free-text AI_SQL_GENERATION and AI_QUESTION_CATEGORIZATION instructions.

verifiedQueries.n: AI_VERIFIED_QUERIES stored in the semantic view; Verified Query Repository. Optimization from verified queries is Preview.

nl2sql.n: Cortex Analyst API, Cortex Agents, CoWork. Since Aug 2026 Snowflake recommends Cortex Agents over standalone Cortex Analyst.

ontology.n: No object, link or action layer. Semantic views cover tables, relationships, metrics. Ossie has an Ontology working group.

graph.n: No graph query feature in SQL command or function indexes. Partner apps: Neo4j Graph Analytics, RelationalAI.

vector.n: VECTOR type GA May 2024. Cortex Search (vector plus keyword) GA Oct 2024. Dimensions can bind a Search service.

mcp.n: Managed MCP server GA Nov 2025. Tools: Cortex Analyst on a semantic view, Search, Agents, SQL, custom. Limit 50 tools.

governance.n: RBAC grants, tags, ACCOUNT_USAGE views, agent lineage. Masking and row access policies apply at query time. verified_by is free text.

openStandard.n: Ossie (formerly OSI) YAML import and export, Preview since Jun 2026. Native YAML, GET_DDL, dbt package and Terraform also exist.

offers: Semantic Views: schema-level objects with logical tables, relationships, facts, dimensions, metrics and synonyms that agents read as context.
Verified queries and text instructions live inside the semantic view, so they follow its grants and shares.
Cortex Agents and CoWork generate SQL directly from semantic views and run it under Snowflake roles.
Managed MCP server exposes semantic views, Cortex Search, agents and SQL execution to external MCP clients with RBAC.
Autopilot drafts a semantic view from tables, query history, example SQL, Power BI files or Tableau files.
Plain SQL queries on semantic views (SEMANTIC_VIEW clause or AGG) work from any SQL client.
gaps: No ontology layer (objects, links, actions) and no native graph query. Graph work needs a partner Native App.
Semantic views live inside Snowflake. A metric layer shared with other warehouses needs an external tool.
Ossie spec is pre-1.0 (0.1.1 released, 0.2.0 draft) and Snowflake import and export is Preview.
Several parts are Preview: relationship paths, range joins, materializations, TDS export, Horizon Context, verified-query optimization.
Names and entry points changed in 2026 (Intelligence to CoWork, Analyst to Agents), so older tutorials and response formats lag.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Model the data as a semantic view with synonyms, sample values, verified queries and instructions, then add it as a tool on a Cortex Agent. Call the agent through the Agents Run API, CoWork or the managed MCP server. Use Autopilot or Semantic Studio to draft the view and keep the definition in Git through dbt or Terraform.

snippet.title: Minimal CREATE SEMANTIC VIEW over TPC-H sample data (adapted from the official example)
snippet.code:
CREATE SEMANTIC VIEW tpch_rev_analysis
  TABLES (
    orders AS SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS PRIMARY KEY (o_orderkey) WITH SYNONYMS ('sales orders'),
    customers AS SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.CUSTOMER PRIMARY KEY (c_custkey)
  )
  RELATIONSHIPS ( orders_to_customers AS orders (o_custkey) REFERENCES customers )
  DIMENSIONS (
    customers.customer_name AS customers.c_name WITH SYNONYMS = ('customer name'),
    orders.order_year AS YEAR(o_orderdate) COMMENT = 'Year when the order was placed'
  )
  METRICS (
    orders.order_average_value AS AVG(orders.o_totalprice) COMMENT = 'Average order value across all orders'
  )
  COMMENT = 'Semantic view for revenue analysis';

notes.topic: OSI: who started it and when
notes.text: Snowflake announced Open Semantic Interchange (OSI) on 2025-09-23 as an open source initiative for a vendor-neutral semantic model spec. Snowflake leads it. The press release names Salesforce (with Tableau), BlackRock, dbt Labs and RelationalAI as launch partners.

sources.t: Snowflake press release: Open Semantic Interchange Initiative

notes.text: The Sep 2025 coalition also listed Alation, Atlan, Blue Yonder, Cube, Elementum AI, Hex, Honeydew, Mistral AI, Omni, Select Star, Sigma and ThoughtSpot. The Snowflake Jul 2026 post says 17 launch partners but does not name them, and now counts more than 50 organizations. The press release does not use the term founding members.

sources.t: Snowflake press release: Open Semantic Interchange Initiative

notes.text: Nov 2025 additions: AWS, Collibra, DataHub, Domo, Firebolt, Informatica, Instacart, JPMC, Preset, Starburst Data, Strategy. Jan 2026 additions: AtScale, Coalesce, Collate, Credible, Databricks, JetBrains, Lightdash, Qlik. Denodo joined in Mar 2026 and Kyvos in Aug 2026.

sources.t: Snowflake blog: OSI initiative expands partners (2025-11-13)

notes.topic: OSI spec status, version and license in 2026
notes.text: The spec is under Apache License 2.0, and the spec file lists release 0.1.1 dated 2025-12-11 (Snowflake announced the first version on 2026-01-27). On 2026-10-24 the main branch shows 0.2.0.dev0, marked draft and unreleased, with osi-0.1.1-rc1 as the only git tag. A v1.0 target was named in Nov 2025 with no date.

sources.t: Snowflake blog: OSI initiative expands partners

notes.text: Open Semantic Interchange entered the Apache Incubator on 2026-06-22 and was renamed Apache Ossie (incubating), to avoid confusion with the Open Source Initiative acronym. The rename was announced on 2026-07-08 (Snowflake blog) and 2026-07-10 (ossie.apache.org). Spec, community and mission are unchanged, and the code lives at github.com/apache/ossie. The ASF notes that incubation does not mean the code is complete or stable.

sources.t: Apache Ossie enters the Apache Incubator
dbt Labs: OSI is now Apache Ossie

notes.topic: Snowflake support for Ossie and OSI YAML
notes.text: Snowflake documents SYSTEM$CREATE_SEMANTIC_VIEW_FROM_OSSIE_YAML and SYSTEM$READ_OSSIE_YAML_FROM_SEMANTIC_VIEW, with Snowflake-only features kept in vendor extensions. The older OSI-named procedure is marked deprecated. The Preview features list shows OSI YAML for semantic views as Preview since Jun 2026, and the docs example uses spec version 0.1.1.

notes.topic: Product rename: Snowflake Intelligence to Snowflake CoWork
notes.text: Snowflake Intelligence became Snowflake CoWork and Cortex Code became CoCo, announced at Snowflake Summit on 2026-06-02. Current Snowflake docs use the CoWork and CoCo names, and the 2025 GA release note for Snowflake Intelligence now points to the CoWork overview.

sources.t: Snowflake press release: Snowflake CoWork (formerly Snowflake Intelligence), 2026-06-02

notes.topic: Is the semantic model YAML file path legacy?
notes.text: Yes for the stage file. Snowflake calls stage-based semantic model YAML the legacy stage API: it still works with Cortex Analyst, but semantic views are recommended for new work and stage files lack SQL querying and native sharing. YAML is still a valid way to author a semantic view through SYSTEM$CREATE_SEMANTIC_VIEW_FROM_YAML and Semantic Studio.

notes.text: Semantic views: Preview 2025-04-17, defining them GA at Summit in June 2025, querying GA in Aug 2025. Standard SQL clauses on semantic views GA 2026-03-02, Semantic Studio GA 2026-09-30, Cortex Agents and managed MCP server GA 2025-11-04. Preview items: USING relationship paths, range joins, materializations, TDS export, Horizon Context (2026-10-12).

Managed MCP server GA release note

notes.text: A semantic view is a schema-level object, so you grant SELECT on the view and need no SELECT on its base tables, as with standard views. Snowflake docs say masking and row access policies are enforced at the query engine when agents query data. Tags work on semantic views and their members since May 2026, and lineage links table, semantic view and agent since Sep 2026.

Sep 2026 release note: lineage for Cortex Agents

notes.topic: BI tool support for semantic views
notes.text: Inbound: Autopilot builds a semantic view from a Power BI file (GA 2026-08-18; DAX measures become metrics) or a Tableau file. Outbound: SYSTEM$EXPORT_TDS_FROM_SEMANTIC_VIEW makes a Tableau data source (Preview, Mar 2026). I did not verify native semantic view support inside other BI tools.

sources.t: Power BI ingestion GA release note

notes.text: I found no property graph, SQL/PGQ or Cypher feature in the Snowflake SQL command and function indexes. Neo4j documents Graph Analytics for Snowflake (graph algorithms on Snowpark Container Services), and RelationalAI lists a Snowflake Native App with graph reasoning.

Horizon Catalog is the catalog layer for descriptions, tags, lineage and access control. Horizon Context (Preview, 2026-10-12) adds metadata connectors to 18 external sources such as Power BI, Tableau, dbt, Databricks and BigQuery. The connectors read metadata from external systems.

Semantic View Autopilot has no Preview label in docs and Power BI ingestion for it is GA, but I found no GA release note; Flexera (third party) says GA since Feb 2026. Tableau ingestion status, Cortex Analyst exact GA date (Preview Aug 2024), and third-party BI tools reading semantic views are unverified.
